query:
SELECT u.id, u.display_name
            FROM users u
            JOIN group_members gm ON u.id = gm.user_id
            WHERE gm.group_id = $1 AND u.tenant_id = $2
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM user_groups g
                  WHERE g.id = gm.group_id AND g.tenant_id = $2
              )
